messages:
maria.g: quick sync  evening mini-booth on the terrace: courier ETA 16:20, load-in at 16:45. can we tighten to a 20m handoff window?

jess: 20m is tight but doable if we have two people at Dock C. i can be on site by 16:00 to set up. who's the other?

leo: i'll be on-site but need to drop a keycard to security first. recommend 16:40-17:00 window to be safe. dock access code is 3321 (temp).

maria.g: ops-bot says docks alternate, so we need to confirm 1hr before. ops-bot, please reconfirm 1hr prior and ping courier.

ops-bot: Affirmative. Will ping 1 hour prior to thread time. Venue rule: no demo electronics past 18:00 without prior authorization. Loading Dock: Dock C. Contact: Marco (marco@terracevenue.com).

priya: swag update: delivered today. counts: 2k stickers, 400 shirts (mixed unisex S-L), 300 notepads, 50 plushies. i left a fragile mark on plushies. courier requested itemized manifest.

maria.g: share manifest here when you have it. we need SKU tags for customs and venue log. also any oversized crates?

priya: manifest attached in my notes (short version):
```
- RED-STK-02: 2000 stickers (20 boxes)
- RED-TEE-01: 400 shirts (10 boxes)
- RED-NPD-01: 300 notepads (6 boxes)
- RED-PLUSH-01: 50 mascots (1 crate, fragile)
- Booth electronics: 3 crates (monitors + streaming rigs, labelled FRAGILE)
```

samira: routing note for leads captured at the terrace demos: QR must pass utm_medium=booth_utls and a param 'shift' (evening/morning) so we can split follow-ups. also ensure 'interest' form field maps to campaign taxonomy.

jess: which QR are we printing on the table cards? i have a sheet with 30 cards. need final URL.

leo: final URL: https://redwood.ai/terrazine?utm_source=terrace&utm_campaign=q3-field&utm_medium=booth_utls&shift=evening . we will generate short QR for print.

maria.g: lightning talk: we got 8-min slot at 18:15 on demo stage. want to focus on "benchmarks to customer value" angle: 3 quick numbers (latency, cost per 1k tokens, avg ROI of embedding-powered search). who can pull numbers?

samira: i can pull the bench numbers this morning (prod averages) and format into one slide. will include source notes. need clearance on the ROI stat (marketing owns that).

priya: marketing ROI stat: "customers reduced search latency by 70% and saw 2.3x session retention"  permitted for public. use footnote: internal case study Q2.

jess: deck logistics: bring HDMI dongle + mini DP, and backup USB with slides. i'll handle the AV check at 17:30.

maria.g: inbound lead flow: plan is scan -> webhook POST to /api/leads/webhook -> triage rules: enterprise->AE assign, pql->product-led-nurture, otherwise general-marketing. label format for stickers we print at the booth? two-line thermal: NAME | COMPANY on first line, TAGS on second. tags: source:terrace, shift:evening, campaign:q3-field, interest:<freeform>.

leo: test window: can we run a dry run at 17:00? I'll bring a test badge. ops-bot, can you simulate webhook delivery?

ops-bot: Simulating test POST at 17:00 to /api/leads/test. Expect status 200 within 3s.

samira: i'll confirm the backend maps 'interest' into our CRM fields and that AE queue triggers. also adding fallback email: ae-fallback@redwood.com in case assignment fails.

maria.g: good. last: returns/leftover swag plan. venue charges storage after 20:00. plan A: pack leftovers into courier crate and schedule pickup for 20:30. plan B: if crate weight >250lbs, we'll ship to office next day. agree?

priya: agree. i'll do a quick post-teardown count and flag heavy crates. also will mark plushies as return-only (fragile).

jess: teardown team: me + leo + volunteer (samira) from 20:00 to 21:00. we'll palletize leftovers by 20:20.

maria.g: perfect. i'll pin this thread to the runbook and add checklist items: courier window, manifest, QR final URL, lightning deck, dry run, returns. thanks all :thumbsup:
